stories.title: New Apple CEO John Ternus's first post: "hello"
stories.summary: John Ternus, Apple's former head of hardware engineering, took over as CEO on Sep 1 and made his first post on X: "hello". It got 547K likes and 71.6K replies. Elon Musk quoted it with "New Apple CEO posting on 𝕏", and Merriam-Webster pointed out that "hello" is younger than both "hey" and "hi".
